subject: Using date for x axis on multi-year plots

messages.author: 7dc9525125ca03d3
messages.subject: Using date for x axis on multi-year plots
parts:
Thanks to Brandon I have the following code which produces a plot showing moth trap numbers over two seasons.  I have another question featuring the same datasets.  I got the plot working using day of year on the x axis using Brandon's code:

ggplot () +
geom_vline(data = all.fronts, aes(xintercept = doy)) +
geom_line(data = cewall, aes(x = doy, y = avgmoths, color=variable)) +
facet_grid (year~., scales = "free_y")

...but I'd prefer to use the actual date on the x axis. The data cover two fall seasons, not whole years.  However, simply switching the x assignment from DOY to date, in the code below, sets the x axis scale to the whole dataset in each panel, even though it properly displays just the one season of data corresponding to the facet variable in each panel.

ggplot () +
geom_vline(data = all.fronts, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date))) +
geom_line(data = cewall, aes(x=date, y = avgmoths, color=variable)) +
facet_grid (year~., scales = "free_y")

I can think of two possible solutions: simply use day+month instead of day+month+year, but is there a way to represent that in R date types?  The second is to subset the data by year in the geom_ line, but how do I say "year==year" in a way that ggplot understands to subset using the facet variable?  GGplot is pretty elegant, so there should be some way to access that facet variable to subset the data in both datasets, but I don't see it.  Data are below.

Thanks,
Jennifer

messages.subject: Re: Using date for x axis on multi-year plots
parts:
On Sun, Nov 8, 2015 at 9:19 AM, Jennifer Krauel <unquench...@gmail.com> wrote:

ggplot () +
geom_vline(data = all.fronts, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date))) +
geom_line(data = cewall, aes(x=date, y = avgmoths, color=variable)) +
facet_grid (year~., scales = "free_y")

Jennifer, 
I've not done a lot of work where I need to have date formats and they are notoriously difficult to work with in general. Timezones and leap years are a PITA. 

Anyway, I think I'm close to what you want. From here: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29974535/dates-with-month-and-day-in-time-series-plot-in-ggplot2-with-facet-for-years

ggplot () +
geom_vline(data = all.fronts, aes(xintercept = doy)) +

geom_line(data = cewall, aes(x = doy, y = avgmoths, color=variable)) +  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(as.Date(as.character(x), "%j"), "%m-%d")) + facet_grid(year ~ ., scales = "free_x")

# Looks like you use your day of year (doy) data and then format the axis labels. I tried to do it the other way, but it wouldn't facet right due to the linear nature of time.

ggplot () +
geom_vline(data = all.fronts, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date))) +

geom_line(data = cewall, aes(x = date, y = avgmoths, color=variable)) + scale_x_date() + facet_grid(year ~ ., scales = "free")

# the vline fix was found here: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5388832/how-to-get-a-vertical-geom-vline-to-an-x-axis-of-class-date
